shortDescription: Retrieve zone information in Hetzner DNS service

options.name: hetzner_api_token
options.description: The token for the new Hetzner DNS API. If not provided, will be read from the environment variable E(HETZNER_API_TOKEN). Exactly one of O(hetzner_token) and O(hetzner_api_token) must be provided.

options.name: hetzner_token
options.description: The token for the classic Hetzner DNS API. If not provided, will be read from the environment variable E(HETZNER_DNS_TOKEN). Exactly one of O(hetzner_token) and O(hetzner_api_token) must be provided.

options.name: zone_id
options.description: The ID of the DNS zone to query. Exactly one of O(zone_name) and O(zone_id) must be specified.

options.name: zone_name
options.description: The DNS zone to query. Exactly one of O(zone_name) and O(zone_id) must be specified.
